verdict.rationale: Browser-extension autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence describes such an extension. The docs instead show users manually entering codes from the app, an Autofill section used only to export passwords (a feature community reports say is being discontinued), and passkey sign-in inside the mobile app. None of that is browser-extension autofill.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
